editable training systems for tool-using agents
text:
1. **Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning** — An extensible system that trains existing tool-using agents with minimal code changes. Xufang Luo, Yuge Zhang, Zhiyuan He, Zilong Wang, Siyun Zhao, Dongsheng Li, Luna K. Qiu, and Yuqing Yang — **Microsoft Research**.  
   https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.03680

2. **A Self-Improving Coding Agent (SICA)** — A tool-equipped agent that edits its own implementation and evaluates whether those edits improve performance. Maxime Robeyns, Martin Szummer, and Laurence Aitchison — **University of Bristol and iGent AI**.  
   https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.15228

3. **RandomWorld: Procedural Environment Generation for Tool-Use Agents** — Generates editable, interactive tools and compositional tasks for SFT and online reinforcement learning. Michael Sullivan, Mareike Hartmann, and Alexander Koller — **Saarland University / Saarland Informatics Campus**.  
   https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.936/

4. **ToolSelf: Unifying Task Execution and Self-Reconfiguration** — Lets an agent modify its goals, strategy, toolbox, knowledge, and context policy while executing a task, with a two-stage training method for learning that behavior. Jingqi Zhou, Sheng Wang, Dezhao Deng, Junwen Lu, Junwei Su, Qintong Li, Jiahui Gao, Hao Wu, Lingpeng Kong, Chuan Wu, and colleagues — **University of Hong Kong and Chinese University of Hong Kong**.  
   https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07883

5. **ToolACE-R: Model-aware Iterative Training and Adaptive Refinement for Tool Learning** — Iteratively adjusts training examples to the model’s evolving capabilities and teaches agents to refine tool calls. Xingshan Zeng, Zezhong Wang, Liangyou Li, Yasheng Wang, Lifeng Shang, Xin Jiang, Ruiming Tang, Qun Liu, and collaborators — **Huawei Technologies, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, University of Science and Technology of China, and Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen)**.  
   https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40759
